name: John Thune
role: US Senator from South Dakota (since 2005); Senate Majority Leader (since 2025); US Representative 1997-2003
summary: John Thune is a Republican US Senator from South Dakota and Senate Majority Leader. His record is consistently conservative: against the ACA, Dodd-Frank and same-sex marriage laws, for restrictions on abortion, fossil fuel production, work requirements for benefits, voter ID and a strong military. He voted for FISA and Patriot Act extensions and NATO expansion. This audit rests mainly on votes and floor speeches, so many statements are left unanswered.
